title: Record every Moniepoint POS sale in a table
summary: Every time one of your Moniepoint terminals takes a payment, keep it in a data table: terminal, amount, kind, whether it was approved.
description: Whenever Moniepoint reports a transaction on one of your POS terminals (a card purchase, a transfer to the terminal, a withdrawal, a bill payment), adds a row to your POS sales table with the terminal, the kind, the amount in naira, the day, whether it was approved and the terminal's answer. This is the record the POS summary and cash-up workflows read. Connect your terminals once under Connections (Taskiem shows where in Moniepoint Business to create the webhook subscription); every terminal of the business is covered. Nothing is sent to anyone.
